frontier: OEIS A385316: smallest N expressible as sum of three prime cubes (p³+q³+r³, p≤q≤r) in exactly 6 ways — what is a(6)?
action:
Milestone: bounded_exact_search; contract=sha256:5c3f895292d59b11fc8f37a0f70c223f24ee5aa5a6d73b5948bfd5c1e9c4c69b
Implemented and ran the numpy-based two-pass census at C=10¹² using a385316_census_v2.py. Enumerated all unordered prime-cube triplets (p≤q≤r) with p³+q³+r³≤10¹² via numpy int64 arrays, sorted 234,197,661 sums, and computed multiplicities via numpy.diff runlength encoding. Completed in 75.6 seconds on this Mac with ~3.2 GB RAM. Verified known terms (a(1)=24, a(2)=185527) against C=10⁷ fixtures.
verified:
Domain: N = p³+q³+r³ with p≤q≤r prime, p³+q³+r³ ≤ cutoff, exactly k representations via unordered triplets.
Predicate: max_multiplicity(k) ≥ K implies a(K) exists; max_multiplicity(k) = K-1 implies a(K) > cutoff.
C=10¹² numpy census: 233,511,846 unique numbers, max_multiplicity=5, no multiplicity-6 found.
a(1)=24, a(2)=185527, a(3)=8627527, a(4)=999979163, a(5)=10588881419 — all confirmed consistent with prior C=5×10¹¹ results.
Multiplicity histogram: k=1: 232,830,172; k=2: 677,573; k=3: 4,063; k=4: 36; k=5: 2.
Fixture C=1000: a(1)=24 OK. Fixture C=200k: a(1)=24 OK, a(2)=185527 OK.

result: Negative result: max_multiplicity remains 5 at C=10¹² (same as at C=5×10¹¹). No multiplicity-6 found, tightening the lower bound a(6) > 10¹². The numpy census approach works at C=10¹² in ~76 seconds on this Mac, resolving the prior OOM blockage. Only 2 numbers at multiplicity-5 exist through C=10¹², suggesting a(6) is likely well above 10¹².
next_gate: Either: (1) extend numpy census to C=2×10¹² or C=5×10¹² to probe deeper into the multiplicity-5 tail, or (2) shift to a targeted search around the two known multiplicity-5 numbers to see if a nearby number has multiplicity-6 via local neighborhood probing. The multiplicity-5 count is only 2 at C=10¹², so saturation at that level is near-complete; the frontier is sparse and likely requires targeted heuristics beyond brute-force census for a(6).
boundary_held: No production Atlas writes, external submissions, git pushes, or training. Census executed locally on Mac within budget. No tool calls beyond this point.
